title: Convergence, design and training of continuous-time dropout as a random batch method
abstract: arXiv:2510.13134v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study continuous-time dropout in controlled differential equations. We introduce a random-batch approximation of additive vector fields. On each time interval of length $h$, a random subset of components is activated and rescaled by its inclusion probabilities, yielding an unbiased approximation of the full field. We prove a uniform-in-time mean-square trajectory error of order $\mathcal O(h)$. At the distribution level, we derive Wasserstein and pointwise density estimates, together with global $L^1$ bounds under moment assumptions. For supervised training, we prove uniform $\mathcal O(\sqrt h)$ root-mean-square fluctuations of the randomized objective and an $\mathcal O(h)$ weak error for its expectation, leading to consistency of optimal values and near-minimizers and, under quadratic growth, convergence in control space. translated_title: 作为随机批方法的连续时间dropout的收敛性、设计与训练
translated_abstract: 我们研究受控微分方程中的连续时间dropout。我们引入了加性向量场的一种随机批近似：在每个长度为 $h$ 的时间区间上，随机激活分量的一个子集，并按其包含概率进行重新缩放，从而得到完整向量场的无偏近似。我们证明了时间一致均方轨迹误差为 $\mathcal O(h)$ 阶。在分布层面，我们导出了 Wasserstein 距离和逐点密度估计，以及在矩假设下的全局 $L^1$ 界。对于监督训练，我们证明了随机化目标函数的一致 $\mathcal O(\sqrt h)$ 均方根波动，以及其期望的 $\mathcal O(h)$ 弱误差，从而得到最优值与近似极小化子的一致性，并在二次增长条件下得到控制空间中的收敛性。我们进一步刻画了采样律如何通过包含概率影响误差常数。
tldr: 本文将连续时间dropout构建为受控微分方程的随机批方法，严格证明了其在轨迹误差、分布距离和监督训练目标三个层面上的收敛性，并揭示采样律的包含概率如何影响误差常数。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates continuous-time dropout as a random batch method for controlled differential equations and rigorously proves its convergence at the trajectory, distribution, and supervised-training levels, while characterizing how inclusion probabilities of the sampling law affect the error constants.
